page.notes: The Greek in the first line is printed in a cursive style and some letters are uncertain; the Greek on the first two lines is transcribed as closely as the scan allows. The marginal note reads "a Ub. supr. p. 74. vers." with "74." below it; the transcription of the note is partly uncertain. The word "nibus" at the foot may be the catchword and also the start of the next line; it is given as the catchword. Small specks on the scan are not printed text.
